items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Then I played with Fate a little while on a boat, on an excursion boat.

ctx.x: I never joined a union until I left... Well, I'll come around to that. But I stayed on Doc Moon's Medicine Show through St. Louis, went to St. Louis, and we played across the river from...right across the (?) called Brooklyn, Illinois, and Lovejoy, Illinois. And that's where Fate Marable used to play on the St. Paul; he used to play on the excursion boats. The boats was out of season at the time I was around St. Louis. But Charlie Creath stayed in St. Louis around about that time, and people used to... The…

One thing I must do before we go any further, because we're going to come right back to St. Louis and Charlie Creath behind this... I've neglected to ask you where did Alphonse Picou come into all this? I know he taught you a lot of things.
